answer: The jade schedule is applied in pigment and reef publishes each instalment. A hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and thus 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 933 identities would post 3525 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
